kpis.description_fr: Volume moyen quotidien US Domestic. Décrue post-pic COVID, perte parts Amazon insourcing.
kpis.description_en: US Domestic average daily volume. Post-COVID peak decline, Amazon insourcing share loss.
kpis._verify_reason: Le 10-K indique 'We deliver approximately 15 million ground packages per day' pour le segment US Domestic. La valeur de 17.5M est incorrecte. Pas d'historique YoY trouvé dans l'extrait fourni.

kpis_story.description_fr: UPS annonce 2025 : réduction volume Amazon -50% sur 2 ans (deliveries non-profitables). Catalyst margin recovery via mix premium.
kpis_story.description_en: UPS 2025 announcement: -50% Amazon volume cut over 2 years (unprofitable deliveries). Margin recovery catalyst via premium mix.

kpis_story.description_fr: Stratégie 'Better not Bigger' : focus Healthcare Logistics (cold chain pharma, clinical trials). Acquisition MNX Global Logistics 2024.
kpis_story.description_en: 'Better not Bigger' strategy: Healthcare Logistics focus (cold-chain pharma, clinical trials). MNX Global Logistics 2024 acquisition.

_notes: UPS = parcel delivery. Stratégie 'Better not Bigger' (CEO Tomé) : exit Amazon non-profitable, focus healthcare.
